component.name: Traygolin
component.summary: Unofficial Linux GUI for the Pangolin CLI

description.p: Traygolin is an unofficial GTK4 and Libadwaita tray application for Linux that wraps the official Pangolin CLI. It provides connect and disconnect, login, account and organization switching, exit node selection, status, DNS and routing preferences, and client logs.
Pangolin itself is not included. Install the pangolin CLI separately. Traygolin is not affiliated with Fossorial or Pangolin.
Initial unofficial Linux GUI wrapping the Pangolin CLI.
